_comment: Settings overlay passed to the worker process via --settings. An Ollama model id is not a recognized Claude model, so Claude Code's context-window resolver falls through to its 200000 default and clamps ollama's CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW down to it. CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS overrides the model window itself and is honored for any model id not starting with 'claude-'. Do not set ANTHROPIC_* or CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW here - ollama launch exports those.
